segments.text: August 11, 2026 — As recorded in the meeting minutes:

. Mr. Hazard has shared with them that he has been a victim of the police department twice, and he explained those incidents. He noted that for those incidents, he has received apology letters. He noted he shared with them two months ago and only Council Member Hunter reached out to him to make sure he was satisfied. In June, Council Member Hunter noted the threats they have received. He wanted to make it clear that there was no room for threats on anyone. He came here two weeks ago on his concerns of Officer Kitchen. It was okay to agree to disagree. He was glad he was on the side of protecting children. He hoped the city was right, but if he was right then they all lose.
